Audit result: exact max_output_bytes is forwarded through snapshot API to producer, supervisor, and bounded _read_regular helper-result read; caller timeout/RSS are also forwarded. Invalid caps are rejected before _capture_inputs/worker launch. Dynamic default lookup preserves monkeypatch compatibility and default output cap 8 MiB; DEFAULT_MAX_RSS_BYTES remains 12 GiB. Failure receipts still prioritize timeout/memory/output classifications, with memory_limit_message retaining stop-and-ask-before-retry guidance. No retry path was introduced. Oversized helper result raises from bounded read; runner/process and decode errors propagate as before rather than being silently retried or rewritten.

This review covers only runner/output plumbing and does not accept/certify the source constructor proposal.

author: /root/producer_audit
body: One resource-boundary finding from read-only review. In src/ladon/_proof_contract_source_obligations_staging.py::_write_probe, if the request-derived target already exists as a regular file, the comparison calls target.read_bytes() before any size check. A caller who can preseed that path in repoRoot can make staging read an arbitrarily large file into memory, despite the 8 MiB generated-source/input profile. The same helper is used for both the main probe and strict-prefix probe. Please bound the collision read (e.g. check file size against len(generated) before a bounded read and reject larger files); consider race handling if relying on stat alone. This is not exercised by current frozen tests and I did not modify files.

author: /root/producer_audit
body:
Final bounded integration audit complete. The collision repair addresses #378: both pre-existing-file branches call _check_existing_probe, which rejects symlinks and uses descriptor-based _read_regular with max=len(generated). An oversized regular file fails from fstat before a read; exact expected bytes are accepted without overwrite. I verified the symlink branch short-circuits before reading/following the target, and the helper itself opens the final path with O_NOFOLLOW where supported. No additional actionable defect found in this delta.
